description.value:
Traits Signal

You gain access to The Gap at 10th level even if the Numbers Frequency is not yours, and you can use it while broadcasting any Frequency. Until you reach 15th level it costs 4 Encore instead of 3; from 15th level on it costs 3. If you have the Numbers Frequency, this feat changes only the level and the cost.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 (cost math) stacked on SB4 (The Gap is itself part of the un-encoded `numbers-track`). No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either. All three Frequency-track base auras (Numbers, Open Band, Requiem, and their action-card twins) ship "rules": [] despite describing at-will auras with real numbers. Buildable in principle via Aura + a companion effect (same shape as SB3), unbuildable in practice because no such companion item exists, and because the base aura's own radius/uptime is itself gated on the un-encoded Broadcast (SB3).
